reference_sql:
SELECT p.product_name, a.list_price_eur AS price_mar_2_eur, b.list_price_eur AS price_mar_6_eur
FROM products p
JOIN price_history a ON a.product_id = p.product_id AND DATE '2025-03-02' >= a.valid_from AND (a.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2025-03-02' <= a.valid_to)
JOIN price_history b ON b.product_id = p.product_id AND DATE '2025-03-06' >= b.valid_from AND (b.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2025-03-06' <= b.valid_to)
WHERE p.brand = 'Vistara'
alternatives: SELECT p.product_name, a.list_price_eur AS price_mar_2_eur, b.list_price_eur AS price_mar_6_eur FROM products p JOIN price_history a ON a.product_id = p.product_id AND DATE '2025-03-02' BETWEEN a.valid_from AND COALESCE(a.valid_to, DATE '9999-12-31') JOIN price_history b ON b.product_id = p.product_id AND DATE '2025-03-06' BETWEEN b.valid_from AND COALESCE(b.valid_to, DATE '9999-12-31') WHERE p.brand = 'Vistara'

WITH prices AS (SELECT product_id, valid_from, COALESCE(valid_to, DATE '9999-12-31') AS valid_until, list_price_eur FROM price_history) SELECT p.product_name, a.list_price_eur AS price_mar_2_eur, b.list_price_eur AS price_mar_6_eur FROM products p JOIN prices a ON a.product_id = p.product_id AND DATE '2025-03-02' BETWEEN a.valid_from AND a.valid_until JOIN prices b ON b.product_id = p.product_id AND DATE '2025-03-06' BETWEEN b.valid_from AND b.valid_until WHERE p.brand = 'Vistara'

other_way.sql: SELECT p.product_name, a.list_price_eur AS price_mar_2_eur, b.list_price_eur AS price_mar_6_eur FROM products p JOIN price_history a ON a.product_id = p.product_id AND DATE '2025-03-02' BETWEEN a.valid_from AND COALESCE(a.valid_to, DATE '9999-12-31') JOIN price_history b ON b.product_id = p.product_id AND DATE '2025-03-06' BETWEEN b.valid_from AND COALESCE(b.valid_to, DATE '9999-12-31') WHERE p.brand = 'Vistara'
other_way.tradeoff: BETWEEN with COALESCE is shorter, but the far-off end date is a stand-in for a missing valid_to.

solver.query:
SELECT p.product_name, h2.list_price_eur AS price_mar_2_eur, h6.list_price_eur AS price_mar_6_eur
FROM products p
JOIN price_history h2 ON h2.product_id = p.product_id
  AND h2.valid_from <= DATE '2025-03-02' AND (h2.valid_to IS NULL OR h2.valid_to >= DATE '2025-03-02')
JOIN price_history h6 ON h6.product_id = p.product_id
  AND h6.valid_from <= DATE '2025-03-06' AND (h6.valid_to IS NULL OR h6.valid_to >= DATE '2025-03-06')
WHERE p.brand = 'Vistara'
